title: Classic Mac and Cheese
steps: Boil macaroni according to package directions.
While macaroni is cooking, melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Whisk in flour until smooth, then slowly whisk in milk.
Stir constantly until the mixture thickens, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted and smooth.
Season with salt and pepper.
Drain macaroni and stir into the cheese sauce.
Serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Cook spaghetti according to package directions in salted water.
While pasta cooks, chop guanciale into small cubes and cook in a skillet until crisp.
In a bowl, whisk eggs with grated Pecorino Romano cheese and plenty of black pepper.
Drain the spaghetti, reserving some pasta water.
Toss the hot spaghetti with the guanciale, then quickly pour in the egg and cheese mixture, stirring constantly.
The heat from the pasta will cook the eggs. Add a little pasta water if needed to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately, topped with more cheese and pepper.

title: Simple Tomato Soup
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot. Sauté chopped onion and garlic until soft.
Add canned tomatoes and vegetable broth.
Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and let cook for 15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Stir in heavy cream and fresh basil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.

title: Chickpea Salad
steps: Rinse and drain chickpeas.
Chop cucumber, red onion, and parsley.
Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil.
Toss to combine and serve.

title: Pancakes
steps: In a large bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium-high heat.
Pour or scoop the batter onto the pan.
Cook until bubbles appear on the surface, then flip and cook until browned on the other side.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Slice chicken breast and chop vegetables.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, ginger, and garlic for the sauce.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add chicken and cook until no longer pink. Remove from pan.
Add vegetables to the pan and stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Return chicken to the pan and pour in the sauce.
Stir until everything is coated and heated through.

title: Veggie Omelette
steps: Whisk eggs and milk together in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Chop spinach, mushrooms, and bell pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour egg mixture into the pan.
When the eggs begin to set, add vegetables and cheese.
Fold the omelette in half and cook until the cheese is melted.

title: Simple Tomato Pasta
steps: Cook pasta according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a pan.
Sauté chopped onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add canned tomatoes, break them up with a spoon.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in fresh basil and season with salt and pepper.
Drain pasta and toss with the sauce.
Serve topped with grated parmesan cheese.
